verdict.rationale: The pack shows a public openai/plugins GitHub repo with a curated marketplace manifest and several listed plugins. Nothing in it covers maintenance activity: no release history or cadence, no issue triage, and no accepted community pull requests. A repo existing and a manifest being fetchable say nothing about active upkeep, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection is actively maintained — recent releases, triaged issues, and accepted community contributions
